svg.title: Chat — Server-side transcription (second worker step, sequence)

g.text: Chat — Server-side transcription (second worker step, sequence)
transcribe(path) in a thread → text, language
If the job cannot even be queued (broker down), the audio worker
marks the transcript failed at once; the message stays playable.
Separate compose service + queue so slow CPU inference
never blocks audio processing or delivery.
Catch-up / history responses include transcript fields.
